title: Historical staff holiday and engagement-event coordination - 2021 to 2022
summary: Two restricted staff-event documents show how RTEC historically coordinated optional holiday/engagement activities, including COVID-driven event changes, an ornament exchange, an ugly-sweater contest, a group photo, a café holiday meal and a later snack-day participant list.

claims.claim: A December 2021 staff memorandum states that a recurring seven-days-of-snacks activity was not held because of COVID-19, while an ornament exchange and ugly-sweater contest were retained.
The ornament exchange was voluntary, used a stated $7 limit, and required participants to submit ornaments to designated coordinators before the exchange.

The 2021 holiday schedule also included a café Christmas dinner with an employee entrée discount, an ugly-sweater contest with a set judging time, a scheduled group photo with requested attire, and a timed ornament exchange in the café break area.

A separate main-office Snack Day participant list is internally dated December 15, 2022 even though its filename begins with 2017-12-15; Word metadata shows the file was created and modified in December 2022.

trigger: HR/management organizes a staff holiday or engagement event.
prerequisites: Participation and any cost limits are defined.
actors: Café/event vendor or external photographer when applicable
steps: Decide which events will occur and whether public-health conditions require changes.
Communicate dates, times, locations, participation rules, attire or cost limits.
Collect participant items or sign-ups where needed.
Maintain a participant list only when operationally necessary.
decisions: Whether an event proceeds, changes or is cancelled.
Whether participation is optional and whether a spending cap applies.
exceptions: COVID-19 conditions caused cancellation of at least one recurring activity in 2021.
controls: Do not rely on filename dates when internal document dates/metadata conflict.
Participant names belong in restricted operational records, not generalized knowledge.
unresolved_questions: Are recurring staff-event traditions still active, and who currently owns them?
Is there a standard approval/budget process for employee engagement events?
automation_candidates: Reusable event-memo template with validated date/location/cost/participation fields.
Content-date check that flags filename/document-date conflicts before filing.

provenance.notes: Named participants/coordinators are excluded from generalized knowledge.
